display_name: 三个物理融合模型共享前向的源域等价和速度验证
description: 在固定的112条Phase1源记录上比较三个原有checkpoint的独立与共享前向，保持原批次和精度；不接触测试IQ或真值。

roles.L_s: IQ only; TX identity not read

permissions.claim_scope: source-only numerical equality and observed timing, not a full target prediction guarantee

checkpoint.initialization: three fixed source-trained physical fusion checkpoints
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen source prediction manifests and established source contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: previously verified; strict metadata and model load
checkpoint.selection_rule: all three registered variants, no target selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: fixed-source waveform/gate/class equality, source pilot replay and timings

rows.method: same three fixed fusion models; shared DURA, physical posterior and reader raw/anchor forwards
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical source views

notes: No changes to existing production predictors or their outputs.
One real-checkpoint source-only smoke doubles as the performance observation.
Target completeness and unchanged results require a separate complete, authorized verification before any handover.
